user_request: Build an AI document intelligence platform using AWS. It should allow users to upload PDF documents, extract text using OCR, store documents securely, provide semantic search and question answering using RAG, support user authentication, and expose APIs for integration with other enterprise systems. Prefer reusable open-source solutions where appropriate, but ensure the selected components have suitable licenses and acceptable security/maturity.
normalized_request: An AI-powered document intelligence platform on AWS that enables PDF upload, OCR-based text extraction, secure storage, semantic search with RAG-based question answering, user authentication, and RESTful APIs for enterprise integration.

requirements.description: Users must be able to upload PDF documents through a web interface or API
System must extract text and structured data from PDFs using OCR technology
Uploaded documents must be stored securely with encryption at rest and access controls
Users must authenticate and be authorized to access only permitted documents
System must support semantic search across document content using vector embeddings
System must answer natural language questions about documents using RAG
Platform must expose RESTful APIs for third-party enterprise system integration
System must provide audit logging and monitoring of document access and operations

components.name: PDF_UPLOAD_AND_FILE_MANAGEMENT
components.description: Handles user file uploads, validation, temporary storage, and routing to processing pipeline

components.name: OCR_AND_TEXT_EXTRACTION
components.description: Extracts text and structured data from PDF documents using optical character recognition

components.name: DOCUMENT_STORAGE_AND_SECURITY
components.description: Securely stores original PDF files and extracted content with encryption, versioning, and access controls

components.name: USER_AUTHENTICATION_AND_AUTHORIZATION
components.description: Manages user identity, authentication, role-based access control, and session management

components.name: SEMANTIC_SEARCH_AND_RAG
components.description: Converts document text to embeddings, indexes them in a vector store, retrieves relevant documents, and generates answers using LLM-based RAG orchestration

components.name: ENTERPRISE_REST_API_LAYER
components.description: Exposes RESTful endpoints for document upload, search, question answering, and metadata retrieval for external system integration

components.name: AUDIT_LOGGING_AND_OBSERVABILITY
components.description: Records all user actions, document accesses, and API calls with timestamps and user context for compliance and troubleshooting

components.name: WEB_USER_INTERFACE
components.description: Provides interactive front-end for document upload, search, question answering, and result visualization

execution_plan.objective: Break down the AI document intelligence platform into discrete technical components: PDF upload/handling, OCR, secure storage, semantic search, RAG-based Q&A, user authentication, and API exposure, identifying dependencies and integration points.

Identify open-source and public ecosystem solutions for each component (OCR engines, vector databases, LLM frameworks, authentication systems, API gateways) with their repository locations, version information, license types, and security/maturity indicators.

Assess each candidate solution against licensing compatibility, security posture, maturity level, AWS integration capabilities, scalability, and alignment with enterprise requirements for document intelligence.

Determine for each component whether to REUSE existing open-source solutions, ADAPT existing solutions with modifications, or BUILD custom implementations, providing justification based on evaluation results.

Create a detailed technical architecture blueprint showing component interactions, AWS service selection, data flows, authentication mechanisms, API contracts, and implementation sequences for the chosen REUSE/ADAPT/BUILD decisions.

Verify the blueprint's feasibility, validate license compliance across all components, confirm security requirements are met, and identify any missing dependencies or integration gaps requiring remediation.
